nodes.title: CLIP Text Encode (Positive Prompt)
widgets_values: Four generations of a family seated around a large dining table for Sunday dinner — a great-grandmother, a grandmother, a parent, and a young child. All in plain Sunday clothes. Warm overhead dining room light, a window with afternoon light to one side. Wide shot from a slight elevation, all four generations visible around the table. Cinematic photorealistic style, natural light photography, visible film grain. Warm color palette. No text, no watermark, no logos.
